items.title: Claude can design electronic prototypes from start to finish
items.excerpt: Anthropic had Claude design three devices (speakerphone, voice-assistant hub, handheld virtual pet): specs, component selection, four-layer PCB routing, firmware and CAD-modeled 3D-printed enclosures; the prototypes worked without circuitry fixes.
items.rationale: Primary-source demo of an AI carrying a hardware product from spec through PCB and CAD enclosure to working prototype, which matters directly to industrial and product designers.

items.title: Higgsfield Miracle promises real-time AI video editing, turning any clip into editable layers
items.excerpt: Higgsfield unveiled Miracle (private beta/waitlist): edit a clip while it plays by describing a change, modifying individual objects, lighting and textures as layers without regenerating the footage.
items.rationale: A new product that edits video objects, lighting and textures as layers instead of regenerating the clip. The orchestrator assigned it to design only.

items.title: Instagram's Effect Builder makes new filters from AI prompts
items.excerpt: Instagram's new Effect Builder lets users generate custom Stories AR filters/effects from a text prompt, putting generative effect design in the hands of creators without Spark-style tooling.
items.rationale: Instagram now builds AR effects from a text prompt instead of Spark-style tooling, a shift for creators and AR effect designers.

items.title: AI companies are offering architects six figures for CAD files; have you been approached?
items.excerpt: AI firms are reportedly offering architecture practices six-figure sums for their CAD/BIM archives as training data, raising IP and client-confidentiality questions for design firms.
items.rationale: Practices may soon need to decide whether to sell their CAD/BIM archives as training data, with IP and client-confidentiality stakes. This is a new angle the section has not covered.

items.title: Developers can now build with Google Maps Platform in AI Studio
items.excerpt: Google AI Studio's prompt-to-app builder now integrates Google Maps Platform, so vibe-coded apps can include interactive maps and location features generated from a description.
items.rationale: AI Studio's prompt-to-app builder now generates live maps and location features, so designers can prototype location-based UIs from a single prompt.
